featureCaseStudy.heading: An AI revenue operating layer for the experience economy
featureCaseStudy.description: For Counterfoil, we built Continuum: a foundational RevOps layer that unifies pricing, inventory, and distribution into one coordinated revenue system. A modular, API-first, event-driven platform pairs configurable business rules with model-assisted recommendations, preserving operator control through policy boundaries and override-capable workflows.
